# Matched cohort analysis

::: panel-tabset
```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

merged <- readRDS(here("data", "Merged Data.rds"))%>% 
  filter(ENROLLMENT_to_DISCHARGE >0)%>% 
  select(USUBJID, Hospital, ENROLLMENT_to_DISCHARGE, cmptrsk_status_f, 
         cmptrsk_status_f_new, cmptrsk_status_opt_f, 
         cmptrsk_status_pess_f, Group, CUTI, IAI, PNEUMONIA, BSI, ORIGININFEC_TEXT, 
         SITEID.x, ID_matched, ADMISSION_to_ENROLLMENT, ADMISSION_to_DISCHARGE, SEX, age, CharlsonCI_cat, 
         ICU48, SURGERYREQ, INVASIVEINTUBATIONDEVICE, CENTVASCATHETER,  
         PERIVASCATHETER, URICATHETER, 
         PittScore, Carbapenem_Before_sum, PittScore_4score, IMMUNOSUPPRESSION) %>% 
  distinct()

# Complete NA in Hospital
merged <- merged %>%
  mutate(
    site3 = str_extract(USUBJID, "^\\d{3}"),
    Hospital = na_if(Hospital, ""),
    Hospital = if_else(
      is.na(Hospital),
      case_when(
        site3 == "003" ~ "HTD",
        site3 == "010" ~ "DTH",
        site3 == "027" ~ "VTH",
        site3 == "139" ~ "NLH",
        site3 == "020" ~ "NHTD",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      Hospital
    )
  ) %>%
  select(-site3)

# Delete values of origin infection in NE group

merged$ORIGININFEC_TEXT[merged$Group == "NE"] <- NA

# unique(merged$Hospital)
# 
# table(merged$Group)
# table(merged$cmptrsk_status_f)
# table(merged$cmptrsk_status_f_new)
# table(merged$cmptrsk_status_opt_f)
# table(merged$cmptrsk_status_pess_f)

# category the outcome at discharge
merged <- merged %>%
  mutate(
    cmptrsk_status_f_new = factor(
      cmptrsk_status_f_new,
      levels = c(0, 1, 2),
      labels = c("censored", "death", "recovered")
    )
  )
```

### Table S2. Bacterial species identified from routine microbiological data of the included CRE and CSE patients

```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='hide'}
#========================
# TABLE 1 + IMPORT MICROBIAL -> MERGED 
#========================

#------------------------
# 0) Read data
#------------------------
microbial <- readRDS(here("data", "Microbial Data.rds"))

#------------------------
# 1) Clean ORGANISM
#------------------------
microbial <- microbial %>%
  mutate(
    ORGANISM_clean = ORGANISM %>%
      str_trim() %>%
      str_to_lower()
  )

#------------------------
# 2) Create bacteria variables AT enrollment
#------------------------
microbial <- microbial %>%
  mutate(
    a_baumannii = if_else(
      Period == "Before Enrollment" &
        ORGANISM_clean %in% c(
          "a. baumannii", "a.baumanii","a.baumannii","a.baumannii, p.aeruginosa","acinetobacter baumannii","candida albicans, a.baumannii"
        ),
      1L, 0L
    ),

    p_aeruginosa = if_else(
      Period == "Before Enrollment" &
        ORGANISM_clean %in% c(
          "p. aeruginosa", "p.aeruginosa", "pseudomonas aeruginosa", "p.aeruginosa", "pseudomonas","p. aeruginosa"
        ),
      1L, 0L
    ),

    k_pneumoniae = if_else(
      Period == "Before Enrollment" &
        ORGANISM_clean %in% c(
          "k. pneumoniae", "k.pneumoniae","k.pneumoniae 21","klebsiella pneumoniae"
        ),
      1L, 0L
    ),

    k_aerogenes = if_else(
      Period == "Before Enrollment" &
        ORGANISM_clean %in% c(
          "e.aerogenes", "k.aerogenes","klebsiella aerogenes", "enterococcus aerogenes"
        ),
      1L, 0L
    ),

    other_klebsiella = if_else(
      Period == "Before Enrollment" &
        ORGANISM_clean %in% c("klebsiella spp","klebsiella"),
      1L, 0L
    ),

    e_coli = if_else(
      Period == "Before Enrollment" &
        ORGANISM_clean %in% c("e. coli", "e.coli","e.coli", "escherichia coli", "e.ccoli"),
      1L, 0L
    ),

    e_cloacae = if_else(
      Period == "Before Enrollment" &
        ORGANISM_clean %in% c(
          "e. cloacae", "e.cloacae", "e.cloacea", "e.clocecae (dịch màng phổi)", "enterobacter cloacae"
        ),
      1L, 0L
    ),

    p_mirabilis = if_else(
      Period == "Before Enrollment" &
        ORGANISM_clean %in% c("p.mirabilis","proteus mirabilis"),
      1L, 0L
    ),

    s_marcescens = if_else(
      Period == "Before Enrollment" &
        ORGANISM_clean %in% c("s.marcescens","serratia marcescens","s.mancescens"),
      1L, 0L
    ),

    c_braakii = if_else(
      Period == "Before Enrollment" &
        ORGANISM_clean %in% c("c.braakii"),
      1L, 0L
    ),
    # no case of b. cepacia at enrollment
    # b_cepacia = if_else(
    #   Period == "Before Enrollment" &
    #     ORGANISM_clean %in% c("b.cepacia", "burkholderia cepacia", "b.cepacia"),
    #   1L, 0L
    # ),

    s_aureus = if_else(
      Period == "Before Enrollment" &
        ORGANISM_clean %in% c("s.aureus","s. aureus","staphylococcus aureus"),
      1L, 0L
    ),

    e_faecium = if_else(
      Period == "Before Enrollment" &
        ORGANISM_clean %in% c("e.faecium","e. faecium","enterococcus faecium"),
      1L, 0L
    ),

    candida_spp = if_else(
      Period == "Before Enrollment" &
        ORGANISM_clean %in% c(
          "c.albicans", "c.parapsilosis", "c.tropicalis", "candida albicans", "candida krusei", "candida sp", "candida tropicalis","s.albicans", "candida albicans", "c.tropicalis", "c.krusei","c.glabrata", "c. tropicalis","c.albicans","c. parapsilosis", "c. albicans"
        ),
      1L, 0L
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    others = if_else(
      Period == "Before Enrollment" &
        rowSums(across(
          c(a_baumannii, p_aeruginosa, k_pneumoniae, k_aerogenes,
            other_klebsiella, e_coli, e_cloacae, p_mirabilis, s_marcescens,
            c_braakii, s_aureus, e_faecium, candida_spp),
          ~ as.integer(.x == 1L)
        )) == 0,
      1L, 0L
    ),
    n_species_before = a_baumannii + p_aeruginosa + k_pneumoniae + k_aerogenes +
      other_klebsiella + e_coli + e_cloacae + p_mirabilis + s_marcescens +
      c_braakii + s_aureus + e_faecium + candida_spp + others
  )

## Create variable "enterobacteriaceae" at enrollment
enterobacteriaceae_vec <- c(
  # Escherichia coli
  "e.coli","e. coli","escherichia coli","e.ccoli",
  # Klebsiella
  "k.pneumoniae","k. pneumoniae","klebsiella pneumoniae","k.pneumoniae 21",
  "klebsiella","klebsiella spp",
  "klebsiella aerogenes","k.aerogenes","e.aerogenes", "enterococcus aerogenes",
  # Enterobacter
  "enterobacter","enterobacter cloacae","e. cloacae","e.cloacae","e.cloacea",
  "e.clocecae (dịch màng phổi)",
  # Proteus
  "p.mirabilis","proteus mirabilis","proteus spp",
  # Salmonella / Serratia / Citrobacter / Pantoea
  "salmonella group d","serratia marcescens","s.marcescens","s.mancescens",
  "c.braakii","pantoea spp"
)

microbial <- microbial %>%
  mutate(
    ORGANISM_clean = ORGANISM %>%
      str_trim() %>%
      str_to_lower(),
    enterobacteriaceae = if_else(
      ORGANISM_clean %in% enterobacteriaceae_vec,
      1L, 0L,
      missing = 0L
    )
  )


micro_vars <- c(
  "a_baumannii","p_aeruginosa","k_pneumoniae","k_aerogenes","other_klebsiella",
  "e_coli","e_cloacae","p_mirabilis","s_marcescens","c_braakii","s_aureus",
  "e_faecium","candida_spp", "others"
)


#------------------------
# 3) Bring Group from merged -> microbial (microbial2)
#------------------------
# Check duplicates in merged (optional)
merged %>%
  count(USUBJID) %>%
  summarise(
    n_id = n(),
    n_dup = sum(n > 1),
    max_n = max(n)
  )

id_group <- merged %>%
  select(USUBJID, Group) %>%
  distinct()

microbial2 <- microbial %>%
  left_join(id_group, by = "USUBJID")

# Check merge result (optional)
microbial2 %>%
  summarise(
    n_total = n(),
    n_has_group = sum(!is.na(Group)),
    n_missing_group = sum(is.na(Group))
  )

# Show IDs not in merged (optional)
# anti_join(microbial, id_group, by = "USUBJID") %>%
#   distinct(USUBJID) %>%
#   slice_head(n = 20)

# Fill missing Group as CRE
# microbial2$Group[is.na(microbial2$Group)] <- "CRE"
# unique(microbial2$Group)

#------------------------
# 4) Table n (%) of micro_vars by Group (At enrollment)
#------------------------

tab_micro_by_group <- microbial2 %>%
  filter(Period == "Before Enrollment") %>%
  select(USUBJID, Group, all_of(micro_vars)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(micro_vars),
    names_to = "organism",
    values_to = "flag"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    flag = as.integer(flag)  
  ) %>%
  group_by(Group, organism) %>%
  summarise(
    n = sum(flag == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    denom = n(),  
    pct = 100 * n / denom,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(`n (%)` = sprintf("%d (%.1f)", n, pct)) %>%
  arrange(match(organism, micro_vars), Group)

tab_micro_by_group_wide <- tab_micro_by_group %>%
  select(organism, Group, `n (%)`) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Group, values_from = `n (%)`)


micro_vars2 <- c(
  "k_pneumoniae", "k_aerogenes", "other_klebsiella", "e_coli",  "e_cloacae", "p_mirabilis", "s_marcescens", "c_braakii", "others"
)

tbl_micro_before <- microbial2 %>%
  filter(
    Period == "Before Enrollment",
    Group %in% c("CRE", "CSE")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Group = factor(Group, levels = c("CRE", "CSE"))
  ) %>%
  select(Group, all_of(micro_vars2)) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(micro_vars2), ~ as.integer(.x))) %>%
  tbl_summary(
    by = Group,
    type = all_of(micro_vars2) ~ "dichotomous",
    value = all_of(micro_vars2) ~ 1,
    statistic = all_of(micro_vars2) ~ "{n} ({p}%)",
    digits = all_of(micro_vars2) ~ c(0, 1),
    missing = "no"
  ) %>%
  modify_header(label = "**Organism before enrollment**") %>%
  bold_labels()
```

### Table 1. Baseline characteristics before enrolment of patients in the matched cohort

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE, results='hide'}
######################################################################################
#------------------------
# 5) merge microbial data into patient (merged) data
#------------------------


# 1) Take only variable microorganism "At Enrollment" 
micro_before_pt <- microbial %>%
  filter(Period == "Before Enrollment") %>%
  group_by(USUBJID) %>%
  summarise(
    # with variable 0/1: take max -> at least 1 isolate positive =1
    across(
      c(a_baumannii, p_aeruginosa, k_pneumoniae, k_aerogenes, other_klebsiella,
        e_coli, e_cloacae, p_mirabilis, s_marcescens, c_braakii, s_aureus,
        e_faecium, candida_spp, others, enterobacteriaceae),
      ~ as.integer(max(.x, na.rm = TRUE))
    ),

    # n_species_before
    n_species_before = suppressWarnings(max(n_species_before, na.rm = TRUE)),

    # nbr of isolates at enrollment
    n_isolates_before = n(),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  # NA
  mutate(
    n_species_before = if_else(is.infinite(n_species_before), 0L, as.integer(n_species_before))
  )

# 2) Check key variable
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(micro_before_pt$USUBJID))
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(merged$USUBJID))

# 3) merged
merged2 <- merged %>%
  left_join(micro_before_pt, by = "USUBJID")

# Create variable bacteria at enrollment as ceterogy variable
merged2 <- merged2 %>%
  mutate(
    micro_enroll = case_when(
      enterobacteriaceae == 1L & e_coli == 1L           ~ "E. coli",
      enterobacteriaceae == 1L & k_pneumoniae == 1L     ~ "K. pneumoniae",
      enterobacteriaceae == 1L & k_aerogenes == 1L      ~ "Other Klebsiella",
      enterobacteriaceae == 1L & other_klebsiella == 1L ~ "Other Klebsiella",
      enterobacteriaceae == 1L                          ~ "Others",
      TRUE                                              ~ NA_character_
    ),
    micro_enroll = factor(micro_enroll, levels = c("Others", "E. coli", "K. pneumoniae", "Other Klebsiella"))
  )

################################################################################
merged <- merged2

vars_cat <- c(
  "SEX", "Hospital", "ORIGININFEC_TEXT",
  "CUTI", "IAI", "PNEUMONIA", "BSI", "ICU48", "SURGERYREQ",
  "INVASIVEINTUBATIONDEVICE", "CENTVASCATHETER", "PERIVASCATHETER",
  "URICATHETER", "IMMUNOSUPPRESSION", "CharlsonCI_cat",
  "PittScore_4score", "Carbapenem_Before_sum", "e_coli", "k_pneumoniae", "k_aerogenes", "other_klebsiella"
)

vars_cont <- c("age", "ADMISSION_to_ENROLLMENT")

tab1 <- merged %>%
  select(Group, all_of(vars_cat), all_of(vars_cont)) %>%
  tbl_summary(
    by = Group,
    statistic = list(
      all_continuous() ~ "{median} ({p25}, {p75})",
      all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)"
    ),
    digits = all_continuous() ~ 1,
    missing = "ifany",
    missing_text = "NA"
  ) %>%
  add_overall(last = TRUE) %>%
  modify_header(label ~ "**Variable**") %>%
  bold_labels()
```

### Table 2. Clinical outcomes of patients in the matched cohort

```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#========================
# TABLE 2
#========================

merged2 <- merged %>%
  mutate(
    Group = factor(Group, levels = c("CRE", "CSE", "NE")),
    ADMISSION_to_DISCHARGE_days  = as.integer(parse_number(as.character(ADMISSION_to_DISCHARGE))),
    ENROLLMENT_to_DISCHARGE_days = as.integer(parse_number(as.character(ENROLLMENT_to_DISCHARGE)))
  )

#========================
# Function
#========================
fmt_n_pct <- function(n, pct) paste0(n, " (", format(round(pct, 1), nsmall = 1), "%)")
fmt_miqr_int <- function(med, q1, q3) paste0(med, " (", q1, ", ", q3, ")")

# quantile type = 1: returns an observed value (no interpolation)
q_obs <- function(x, p) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0) return(NA_integer_)
  as.integer(stats::quantile(x, probs = p, type = 1, names = FALSE))
}

# median as an observed value:
med_obs <- function(x) q_obs(x, 0.5)

#========================
# 1) n (%) cmptrsk_status_f_new by Group
#========================
tot <- merged2 %>% count(Group, name = "N")

outcome_tab <- merged2 %>%
  count(Group, cmptrsk_status_f_new, name = "n") %>%
  left_join(tot, by = "Group") %>%
  mutate(
    pct = 100 * n / N,
    value = fmt_n_pct(n, pct)
  ) %>%
  select(cmptrsk_status_f_new, Group, value) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Group, values_from = value) %>%
  mutate(Characteristics = as.character(cmptrsk_status_f_new)) %>%
  select(Characteristics, CRE, CSE, NE)

#========================
# 2) Median (IQR) ENROLLMENT_to_DISCHARGE (overall) by Group
#========================
overall_enroll_discharge <- merged2 %>%
  group_by(Group) %>%
  summarise(
    med = med_obs(ENROLLMENT_to_DISCHARGE_days),
    q1  = q_obs(ENROLLMENT_to_DISCHARGE_days, 0.25),
    q3  = q_obs(ENROLLMENT_to_DISCHARGE_days, 0.75),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(value = fmt_miqr_int(med, q1, q3)) %>%
  select(Group, value) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Group, values_from = value) %>%
  mutate(Characteristics = "Time between enrollment and discharge") %>%
  select(Characteristics, CRE, CSE, NE)

#========================
# 3) Median (IQR) ENROLLMENT_to_DISCHARGE by OUTCOME within Group
#========================
by_outcome_enroll_discharge <- merged2 %>%
  group_by(cmptrsk_status_f_new, Group) %>%
  summarise(
    med = med_obs(ENROLLMENT_to_DISCHARGE_days),
    q1  = q_obs(ENROLLMENT_to_DISCHARGE_days, 0.25),
    q3  = q_obs(ENROLLMENT_to_DISCHARGE_days, 0.75),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(value = fmt_miqr_int(med, q1, q3)) %>%
  select(cmptrsk_status_f_new, Group, value) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Group, values_from = value) %>%
  mutate(Characteristics = paste0("  ", cmptrsk_status_f_new)) %>%
  select(Characteristics, CRE, CSE, NE)

#========================
# 4) Median (IQR) ADMISSION_to_DISCHARGE (LOS) overall by Group
#========================
overall_los <- merged2 %>%
  group_by(Group) %>%
  summarise(
    med = med_obs(ADMISSION_to_DISCHARGE_days),
    q1  = q_obs(ADMISSION_to_DISCHARGE_days, 0.25),
    q3  = q_obs(ADMISSION_to_DISCHARGE_days, 0.75),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(value = fmt_miqr_int(med, q1, q3)) %>%
  select(Group, value) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Group, values_from = value) %>%
  mutate(Characteristics = "Length of stay (Time between admission and discharge)") %>%
  select(Characteristics, CRE, CSE, NE)

#========================
# 5) Median (IQR) ADMISSION_to_DISCHARGE by OUTCOME within Group
#========================
by_outcome_los <- merged2 %>%
  group_by(cmptrsk_status_f_new, Group) %>%
  summarise(
    med = med_obs(ADMISSION_to_DISCHARGE_days),
    q1  = q_obs(ADMISSION_to_DISCHARGE_days, 0.25),
    q3  = q_obs(ADMISSION_to_DISCHARGE_days, 0.75),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(value = fmt_miqr_int(med, q1, q3)) %>%
  select(cmptrsk_status_f_new, Group, value) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Group, values_from = value) %>%
  mutate(Characteristics = paste0("  ", cmptrsk_status_f_new)) %>%
  select(Characteristics, CRE, CSE, NE)

#========================
# 6) Stack into one table
#========================
hdr <- function(x) tibble(Characteristics = x, CRE = "", CSE = "", NE = "")

table_final <- bind_rows(
  hdr("Discharged status"),
  outcome_tab,
  hdr("Time between enrollment and discharge (days)"),
  overall_enroll_discharge,
  by_outcome_enroll_discharge,
  hdr("Length of stay (Time between admission and discharge) (days)"),
  overall_los,
  by_outcome_los
)

#========================
# 7) Add N to column headers
#========================
N_group <- merged2 %>%
  count(Group) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Group, values_from = n)

colnames(table_final)[-1] <-
  paste0(names(table_final)[-1], " (N=", as.integer(N_group[1, ]), ")")

# View
gt(table_final)
```

### Table S3. Discharge outcomes for CRE and CSE patients by main bacterial species

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
mergeds3 <- merged2 %>%
  mutate(
    other_kpneu = case_when(
      k_aerogenes  == 1 | other_klebsiella == 1 ~ 1,
      k_aerogenes  == 0 | other_klebsiella == 0 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(gt)

#========================
# 1) Prepare data
#========================

dat_micro_outcome <- bind_rows(
  mergeds3 %>%
    filter(e_coli == 1, Group %in% c("CRE", "CSE")) %>%
    mutate(Organism = "Patients with *E. coli*"),

  mergeds3 %>%
    filter(k_pneumoniae == 1, Group %in% c("CRE", "CSE")) %>%
    mutate(Organism = "Patients with *K. pneumoniae*"),

  mergeds3 %>%
    filter(other_kpneu == 1, Group %in% c("CRE", "CSE")) %>%
    mutate(Organism = "Patients with other *Klebsiella* spp.")
) %>%
  mutate(
    Organism = factor(
      Organism,
      levels = c(
        "Patients with *E. coli*",
        "Patients with *K. pneumoniae*",
        "Patients with other *Klebsiella* spp."
      )
    ),
    Group = factor(Group, levels = c("CRE", "CSE")),
    Outcome = case_when(
      cmptrsk_status_f_new == "death" ~ "Death",
      cmptrsk_status_f_new %in% c("recovered", "recovery") ~ "Recovery",
      cmptrsk_status_f_new == "censored" ~ "Censored",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    Outcome = factor(Outcome, levels = c("Death", "Recovery", "Censored"))
  )

#========================
# 2) Total N for each organism and group
#========================

tbl_N <- dat_micro_outcome %>%
  count(Organism, Group, name = "N") %>%
  mutate(
    Outcome = "",
    row_order = 0,
    value = paste0("N=", N)
  ) %>%
  select(Organism, Group, Outcome, row_order, value)

#========================
# 3) Outcome n (%) for each organism and group
#    Percentage denominator excludes missing outcome
#========================

tbl_outcome <- dat_micro_outcome %>%
  filter(!is.na(Outcome)) %>%
  count(Organism, Group, Outcome, name = "n") %>%
  complete(
    Organism,
    Group,
    Outcome,
    fill = list(n = 0)
  ) %>%
  group_by(Organism, Group) %>%
  mutate(
    denom = sum(n),
    value = if_else(
      denom > 0,
      paste0(n, " (", sprintf("%.1f", n / denom * 100), "%)"),
      "0 (0.0%)"
    ),
    row_order = as.numeric(Outcome)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(Organism, Group, Outcome, row_order, value)

#========================
# 4) Combine and make gt table
#========================

tbl_s3_gt <- bind_rows(tbl_N, tbl_outcome) %>%
  arrange(Organism, row_order) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Group,
    values_from = value,
    values_fill = ""
  ) %>%
  group_by(Organism) %>%
  mutate(
    Organism = if_else(row_number() == 1, as.character(Organism), "")
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(Organism, Outcome, CRE, CSE) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = md("**Table S3. Discharge outcomes for CRE and CSE patients by main bacterial species**")
  ) %>%
  cols_label(
    Organism = "",
    Outcome = "",
    CRE = "CRE patients",
    CSE = "CSE patients"
  ) %>%
  fmt_markdown(columns = Organism) %>%
  cols_align(
    align = "left",
    columns = c(Organism, Outcome)
  ) %>%
  cols_align(
    align = "center",
    columns = c(CRE, CSE)
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_title(groups = "title")
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_borders(
      sides = "bottom",
      weight = px(1)
    ),
    locations = cells_body(
      rows = Outcome == "Censored"
    )
  ) %>%
  tab_options(
    table.font.size = 14,
    table.border.top.style = "none",
    table.border.bottom.style = "solid",
    column_labels.border.top.style = "solid",
    column_labels.border.bottom.style = "none",
    data_row.padding = px(2)
  )

tbl_s3_gt
```

```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)

#========================
# 1) prepare data
#========================
dat_ci <- merged %>%
  transmute(
    Group = factor(Group, levels = c("CRE", "CSE", "NE")),
    time  = as.numeric(parse_number(as.character(ENROLLMENT_to_DISCHARGE))), 
    status = case_when(
      cmptrsk_status_f_new %in% c("censored", 0, "0") ~ 0,
      cmptrsk_status_f_new %in% c("death",    1, "1") ~ 1,
      cmptrsk_status_f_new %in% c("recovered", 2, "2") ~ 2,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(time),
    !is.na(status),
    !is.na(Group),
    time >= 0
  )

#========================
# 2) calculate CIF by cmprsk
#========================
ci <- cmprsk::cuminc(
  ftime   = dat_ci$time,
  fstatus = dat_ci$status,
  group   = dat_ci$Group,
  cencode = 0
)

#========================
# 3) take only CIF of death with 95% CI
#========================
ci_death_df <- imap_dfr(ci, function(x, nm) {
  
  if (!str_detect(nm, " 1$")) return(NULL)
  
  grp <- str_remove(nm, " 1$")
  
  se <- sqrt(x$var)
  
  tibble(
    Group = grp,
    time  = x$time,
    cif   = x$est,
    se    = se,
    lower = pmax(0, cif - 1.96 * se),
    upper = pmin(1, cif + 1.96 * se)
  )
}) %>%
  mutate(
    Group = factor(Group, levels = c("CRE", "CSE", "NE"))
  )

#========================
# 4) Plot with 95% CI
#========================
figure_2 <- ggplot(
  ci_death_df,
  aes(x = time, y = cif, color = Group, fill = Group)
) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper),
    alpha = 0.15,
    color = NA
  ) +
  geom_step(linewidth = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      CRE = "red3",
      CSE = "darkolivegreen3",
      NE  = "dodgerblue3"
    )
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      CRE = "red3",
      CSE = "darkolivegreen3",
      NE  = "dodgerblue3"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Days since enrollment",
    y = "Cumulative mortality",
    color = NULL,
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

figure_2
```

### Table 3. Sub-distribution hazard ratio of death associated with CRE infection compared to CSE and NE from enrolment, adjusted for time between admission and enrolment, and severity indicators: results from the multivariable proportional sub-distribution hazards models in the matched cohort

After checking follow-up after 3 months, we have located censored patients into Recovered, Death, and Unknown.\
For those with an unknown discharge status at the 3-month follow-up, we considered two scenarios:\
- an optimistic scenario in which they eventually recovered,\
- and a pessimistic scenario in which they eventually passed away.

```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#==========================================
############### TABLE 3 ###################
#==========================================

# merged <- saveRDS(merged, here("data", "merged.rds"))

# 02 FEB 2026: Complete NA in Hospital
merged <- merged %>%
  mutate(
    site3 = str_extract(USUBJID, "^\\d{3}"),
    Hospital = na_if(Hospital, ""),
    Hospital = if_else(
      is.na(Hospital),
      case_when(
        site3 == "003" ~ "HTD",
        site3 == "010" ~ "DTH",
        site3 == "027" ~ "VTH",
        site3 == "139" ~ "NLH",
        site3 == "020" ~ "NHTD",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      Hospital
    )
  ) %>%
  select(-site3)

## 11 FEB 2026: Remove patients IAI (If not, bug in COXPHF)
merged <- merged %>%
  dplyr::filter(IAI == FALSE)

# 09 FEB 2026: Create one variable for type of infection
#              and BSI is reference as discussed with C. Hương
merged <- merged %>%
  mutate(
    type_infection = case_when(
      # Pneumonia is priority in case of Pneumonia + (cUTI or BSI)
      PNEUMONIA == TRUE ~ "Pneumonia",
      CUTI == TRUE      ~ "cUTI",
      BSI == TRUE       ~ "BSI",
      TRUE              ~ NA_character_
    ),
    type_infection = factor(type_infection, levels = c("BSI", "cUTI", "Pneumonia"))
  )
## type of infection with No infection as reference
merged <- merged %>%
  mutate(
    type_infection_ne = case_when(
      # ưu tiên Pneumonia nếu đồng thời có Pneumonia + (cUTI hoặc BSI)
      PNEUMONIA == TRUE ~ "Pneumonia",
      CUTI == TRUE      ~ "cUTI",
      BSI == TRUE       ~ "BSI",
      TRUE              ~ "No infection"
    ),
    type_infection_ne = factor(
      type_infection_ne,
      levels = c("No infection", "BSI", "cUTI", "Pneumonia")
    )
  )

#### Create type of infection*Group variable
merged <- merged %>%
  mutate(
    type_infection = trimws(type_infection),
    Group          = trimws(Group),

    infection_group = case_when(
      type_infection == "cUTI"      & Group == "CSE" ~ "1-cUTI-CSE",
      type_infection == "cUTI"      & Group == "CRE" ~ "2-cUTI-CRE",
      type_infection == "BSI"       & Group == "CSE" ~ "3-BSI-CSE",
      type_infection == "BSI"       & Group == "CRE" ~ "4-BSI-CRE",
      type_infection == "Pneumonia" & Group == "CSE" ~ "5-Pneumonia-CSE",
      type_infection == "Pneumonia" & Group == "CRE" ~ "6-Pneumonia-CRE",
      TRUE ~ "0-NE"
    ),

    infection_group = factor(
      infection_group,
      levels = c(
        "1-cUTI-CSE","2-cUTI-CRE",
        "3-BSI-CSE","4-BSI-CRE",
        "5-Pneumonia-CSE","6-Pneumonia-CRE"
      )
    ),
    
    infection_group_ne = case_when(
      infection_group == "2-cUTI-CRE"      ~ "2-cUTI-CRE",
      infection_group == "4-BSI-CRE"       ~ "4-BSI-CRE",
      infection_group == "6-Pneumonia-CRE" ~ "6-Pneumonia-CRE",
      TRUE ~ "0-No-Infection"
    ),

    infection_group_ne = factor(
      infection_group_ne,
      levels = c(
        "0-No-Infection",
        "2-cUTI-CRE",
        "4-BSI-CRE",
        "6-Pneumonia-CRE"
      )
    )
  )


# with(merged, table(type_infection)) # check after creating

merged <- merged %>% 
  mutate_at(vars("cmptrsk_status_f", "cmptrsk_status_f_new", 
                 "cmptrsk_status_opt_f", "cmptrsk_status_pess_f"), as.factor)

# Separate into 2 dataset

merged_cse <- merged %>%
  filter(Group != "NE") %>%
  mutate(
    Group = relevel(as.factor(Group), ref = "CSE"),
    cmptrsk_status_f_new = factor(cmptrsk_status_f_new,
                                  levels = c("censored", "death", "recovered"))
)
merged_ne <- merged %>%
  filter(Group != "CSE") %>%
  mutate(
    Group = relevel(as.factor(Group), ref = "NE"),
    cmptrsk_status_f_new = factor(cmptrsk_status_f_new,
                                  levels = c("censored", "death", "recovered"))
)

# Subdistribution: stratify by hospital and clustered by patient ID


###### Re-weight data for subdistribution

### Death event

## CRE and CSE
wdat1_group_cse <- finegray(Surv(ENROLLMENT_to_DISCHARGE, cmptrsk_status_f_new, type = "mstate") ~ Group + ADMISSION_to_ENROLLMENT + 
                              SEX + age  + type_infection + ORIGININFEC_TEXT +  infection_group +                                     CharlsonCI_cat  + micro_enroll +
                              ICU48 + SURGERYREQ + INVASIVEINTUBATIONDEVICE + CENTVASCATHETER +
                              PERIVASCATHETER + URICATHETER + PittScore +
                              strata(SITEID.x) + ID_matched, 
                            etype="death",
                            data=merged_cse, id=USUBJID)%>% 
  mutate(failcode="death")


## CRE and NE
wdat1_group_ne <- finegray(Surv(ENROLLMENT_to_DISCHARGE, cmptrsk_status_f_new, type = "mstate") ~  Group + ADMISSION_to_ENROLLMENT + 
                             SEX + age   + CharlsonCI_cat  +  #infection_group_ne +
                             ICU48 + SURGERYREQ + INVASIVEINTUBATIONDEVICE + CENTVASCATHETER +
                             PERIVASCATHETER + URICATHETER + PittScore +
                             strata(SITEID.x) + ID_matched, 
                           etype="death",
                           data=merged_ne, id=USUBJID)%>% 
  mutate(failcode="death")

# Fit two models

fit_cse <- coxph(
  Surv(fgstart, fgstop, fgstatus) ~ 
    Group + type_infection + ORIGININFEC_TEXT +
    ADMISSION_to_ENROLLMENT + micro_enroll + 
    ICU48 + SURGERYREQ + INVASIVEINTUBATIONDEVICE +
    CENTVASCATHETER + PERIVASCATHETER + URICATHETER + SEX + age + CharlsonCI_cat +
    PittScore + cluster(ID_matched),
  data = wdat1_group_cse,
  weights = fgwt,
  model = TRUE
)

fit_ne <- coxph(
  Surv(fgstart, fgstop, fgstatus) ~ 
    Group + ADMISSION_to_ENROLLMENT + #infection_group_ne +
    ICU48 + SURGERYREQ + INVASIVEINTUBATIONDEVICE + CENTVASCATHETER +
    PERIVASCATHETER + URICATHETER + SEX + age  + CharlsonCI_cat +
    PittScore + cluster(ID_matched),
  data = wdat1_group_ne,
  weights = fgwt
)


# Make gtsummary tables

tbl_cse <- tbl_regression(
  fit_cse,
  exp = TRUE,
  pvalue_fun = label_style_pvalue(digits = 2)
) %>%
  bold_labels() %>%
  modify_header(label ~ "**Variables**") %>%
  modify_spanning_header(c("estimate", "ci", "p.value") ~ "**CSE model**")

tbl_ne <- tbl_regression(
  fit_ne,
  exp = TRUE,
  pvalue_fun = label_style_pvalue(digits = 2)
) %>%
  bold_labels() %>%
  modify_header(label ~ "**Variables**") %>%
  modify_spanning_header(c("estimate", "ci", "p.value") ~ "**NE model**")

#========================
# Merge into 1 table
#========================
tbl_merged <- tbl_merge(
  tbls = list(tbl_cse, tbl_ne),
  tab_spanner = c("**Relative to CSE**", "**Relative to NE**")
) %>%
  modify_caption("**Cox models (SHR, 95% CI)**") %>%
  bold_labels()

tbl_merged
```

##### Test for proportionality

```{r}
ph_cse <- cox.zph(fit_cse)
ph_ne  <- cox.zph(fit_ne)


ph_cse_tbl <- as.data.frame(ph_cse$table) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("Variable") %>%
  mutate(
    Model = "CRE vs CSE",
    p = signif(p, 3)
  ) %>%
  select(Model, Variable, chisq, df, p)

ph_ne_tbl <- as.data.frame(ph_ne$table) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("Variable") %>%
  mutate(
    Model = "CRE vs NE",
    p = signif(p, 3)
  ) %>%
  select(Model, Variable, chisq, df, p)

ph_test_table <- bind_rows(ph_cse_tbl, ph_ne_tbl)

## Table 

ph_test_table_fmt <- ph_test_table %>%
  mutate(
    Model = factor(Model, levels = c("CRE vs CSE", "CRE vs NE")),
    
    Variable_label = case_when(
      Variable == "Group" ~ "Group",
      Variable == "type_infection" ~ "Type of infection",
      Variable == "ORIGININFEC_TEXT" ~ "Origin of infection",
      Variable == "ADMISSION_to_ENROLLMENT" ~ "Admission to enrollment",
      Variable == "micro_enroll" ~ "Microorganism at enrollment",
      Variable == "ICU48" ~ "ICU within 48 hours",
      Variable == "SURGERYREQ" ~ "Surgery required",
      Variable == "INVASIVEINTUBATIONDEVICE" ~ "Invasive intubation device",
      Variable == "CENTVASCATHETER" ~ "Central vascular catheter",
      Variable == "PERIVASCATHETER" ~ "Peripheral vascular catheter",
      Variable == "URICATHETER" ~ "Urinary catheter",
      Variable == "SEX" ~ "Sex",
      Variable == "age" ~ "Age",
      Variable == "CharlsonCI_cat" ~ "Charlson comorbidity index",
      Variable == "PittScore" ~ "Pitt score",
      Variable == "GLOBAL" ~ "Global test",
      TRUE ~ Variable
    ),
    
    p_display = case_when(
      p < 0.001 ~ "<0.001",
      TRUE ~ sprintf("%.3f", p)
    )
  )

#========================================
# 2. Create gt table
#========================================

tbl_ph_gt <- ph_test_table_fmt %>%
  select(Model, Variable, Variable_label, chisq, df, p, p_display) %>%
  gt(
    rowname_col = "Variable_label",
    groupname_col = "Model"
  ) %>%
  cols_hide(columns = c(Variable, p)) %>%
  cols_label(
    chisq = md("**Chi-square**"),
    df = md("**df**"),
    p_display = md("**P-value**")
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(
    columns = chisq,
    decimals = 2
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(
    columns = df,
    decimals = 0
  ) %>%
  cols_align(
    align = "center",
    columns = c(chisq, df, p_display)
  ) %>%
  tab_header(
    title = md("**Test of proportional subdistribution hazards assumption**"),
    subtitle = md("Fine–Gray proportional subdistribution hazards models")
  ) %>%
  tab_stubhead(label = md("**Variable**")) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_stub(rows = Variable == "GLOBAL")
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold", color = "red"),
    locations = cells_body(
      columns = p_display,
      rows = p < 0.05
    )
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_row_groups()
  ) %>%
  tab_options(
    table.font.size = px(13),
    data_row.padding = px(4),
    heading.title.font.size = px(16),
    heading.subtitle.font.size = px(13),
    table.border.top.width = px(2),
    table.border.bottom.width = px(2)
  ) %>%
  cols_width(
    stub() ~ px(280),
    chisq ~ px(110),
    df ~ px(70),
    p_display ~ px(90)
  ) %>%
  opt_row_striping() %>%
  tab_source_note(
    source_note = md("Red p-values indicate possible evidence against proportionality, using p < 0.05.")
  )

tbl_ph_gt
```

### Table S4-a. Sensitive analysis - Optimistic scenario

After our meeting, I re-run the sensitive analysis\
As Ronald comments, for the censored group that combined with recovery group (optimistic scenario) or with death group (pessimistic scenario), the time from enrollment to discharge should extend to maximum time of enrollment to discharge in the death group for the censored patients who have lower hospitalization days than this cutoff.

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# 1) max time of death patients
t_star <- merged %>%
  filter(cmptrsk_status_f_new == "death") %>%               # death in main analysis
  summarise(t_star = max(ENROLLMENT_to_DISCHARGE, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  pull(t_star)


#=========================== Optimistic scenario =============================#
# 2) Create status for sensitivity: 1=death, 2=recovery (merge 0 and 2 to 2)

  mutate(

      cmptrsk_status_f_new == "death" ~ "death",
      cmptrsk_status_f_new %in% c("censored", "recovered") ~ "recovered",

    ),
    time_sens = case_when(
      cmptrsk_status_f_new %in% c("censored") &

    ),
    status_sens = factor(status_sens, levels = c("recovered", "death"))
  )


# Divide the groups 
merged_cse_sens <- merged_sens %>%
  filter(!(Group %in% "NE")) %>%

merged_ne_sens <- merged_sens %>%
  filter(!(Group %in% "CSE")) %>%

### Death event
```

### Table S5. Subdistribution hazard ratios (SHRs) for mortality associated with carbapenem-resistant Enterobacterales infection, stratified by infection type

In this analysis, we would like to explore in more detail the effect of CRE in specific infection to the mortality.\
By other words, in CRE vs. CSE analysis, we compare: BSI-CRE infection vs. BSI-CSE infection,\
cUTI-CRE infection vs. cUTI-CSE infection,\
and Pneumonia-CRE infection vs. Pneumonia-CSE infection.\
\
In CRE vs. NE analysis, we compare BSI-CRE, cUTI-CRE, and Pneumonia-CRE infection with NE group\

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='hide'}
wdat1_group_cse <- wdat1_group_cse %>%
  mutate(
    infection_group = relevel(as.factor(infection_group), ref = "1-cUTI-CSE")
  )

fit_cse_1 <- coxphf(
  Surv(fgstop, fgstatus) ~ 
    infection_group + ORIGININFEC_TEXT +
    ADMISSION_to_ENROLLMENT + micro_enroll + 
    ICU48 + SURGERYREQ + INVASIVEINTUBATIONDEVICE +
    CENTVASCATHETER + PERIVASCATHETER + URICATHETER + SEX + age + CharlsonCI_cat +
    PittScore,
  data = wdat1_group_cse
)

wdat1_group_cse <- wdat1_group_cse %>%
  mutate(
    infection_group = relevel(as.factor(infection_group), ref = "3-BSI-CSE")
  )

fit_cse_2 <- coxphf(
  Surv(fgstop, fgstatus) ~ 
    infection_group + ORIGININFEC_TEXT +
    ADMISSION_to_ENROLLMENT + micro_enroll + 
    ICU48 + SURGERYREQ + INVASIVEINTUBATIONDEVICE +

)

wdat1_group_cse <- wdat1_group_cse %>%
  mutate(
    infection_group = relevel(as.factor(infection_group), ref = "5-Pneumonia-CSE")
  )

fit_cse_3 <- coxphf(
  Surv(fgstop, fgstatus) ~ 
    infection_group + ORIGININFEC_TEXT +
    ADMISSION_to_ENROLLMENT + micro_enroll + 
    ICU48 + SURGERYREQ + INVASIVEINTUBATIONDEVICE +
    CENTVASCATHETER + PERIVASCATHETER + URICATHETER + SEX + age + CharlsonCI_cat +
    PittScore,
  data = wdat1_group_cse
)


## CRE and NE
wdat1_group_ne <- finegray(Surv(ENROLLMENT_to_DISCHARGE, cmptrsk_status_f_new, type = "mstate") ~  infection_group_ne + ADMISSION_to_ENROLLMENT + 
                             SEX + age   + CharlsonCI_cat  + 
                             ICU48 + SURGERYREQ + INVASIVEINTUBATIONDEVICE + CENTVASCATHETER +
                             PERIVASCATHETER + URICATHETER + PittScore +
                             strata(SITEID.x) + ID_matched, 
                           etype="death",
                           data=merged_ne, id=USUBJID)%>% 
  mutate(failcode="death")

# Fit model

fit_ne <- coxphf(
  Surv(fgstop, fgstatus) ~ 
    infection_group_ne + ADMISSION_to_ENROLLMENT + 
    ICU48 + SURGERYREQ + INVASIVEINTUBATIONDEVICE + CENTVASCATHETER +
    PERIVASCATHETER + URICATHETER + SEX + age  + CharlsonCI_cat +
    PittScore,
  data = wdat1_group_ne
)

# fit_ne


################### MAKE TABLE ###########################################################
# --- 1. Create a fallback model (Normal Cox) for NE ---
# This serves as a backup in case the Firth Cox model (coxphf) fails to converge.

# # 1. (Normal Cox) in case of NA in p-value due to non-convergence in Firth Cox model
formula_str <- "Surv(fgstop, fgstatus) ~ infection_group + ORIGININFEC_TEXT +
                ADMISSION_to_ENROLLMENT + micro_enroll + ICU48 + SURGERYREQ +
                INVASIVEINTUBATIONDEVICE + CENTVASCATHETER + PERIVASCATHETER +
                URICATHETER + SEX + age + CharlsonCI_cat + PittScore"

fit_norm_1 <- coxph(as.formula(formula_str), data = wdat1_group_cse)

formula_ne_str <- "Surv(fgstop, fgstatus) ~ infection_group_ne + ADMISSION_to_ENROLLMENT + 
                   ICU48 + SURGERYREQ + INVASIVEINTUBATIONDEVICE + CENTVASCATHETER + 
                   PERIVASCATHETER + URICATHETER + SEX + age + CharlsonCI_cat + PittScore"
fit_norm_ne <- coxph(as.formula(formula_ne_str), data = wdat1_group_ne)

extract_row <- function(firth_model, normal_model, pattern, display_name) {
  all_names <- names(firth_model$coefficients)
  
  # Find the position of the variable matching the pattern
  idx_f <- grep(pattern, all_names)
  
  if (length(idx_f) == 0) {
    return(data.frame(Variable = display_name, HR = NA, CI_95 = "", P_value = "", p_num = NA))
  }
  
  # Take the first matching position found
  idx_f <- idx_f[1]
  term_name <- all_names[idx_f]
  
  coef_f <- firth_model$coefficients[idx_f]
  hr <- exp(coef_f)
  
  # Attempt to extract Standard Error from Firth model; fallback to Normal model if failed
  se_f <- tryCatch(sqrt(diag(firth_model$var))[idx_f], error = function(e) NA)
  if (is.na(se_f)) {
    norm_summary <- summary(normal_model)$coefficients
    se_to_use <- if(term_name %in% rownames(norm_summary)) norm_summary[term_name, "se(coef)"] else NA
  } else {
    se_to_use <- se_f
  }
  
  # Calculate 95% Confidence Interval text
  ci_text <- if(!is.na(se_to_use)) {
    paste0(round(exp(coef_f - 1.96 * se_to_use), 2), " - ", round(exp(coef_f + 1.96 * se_to_use), 2))
  } else "NC"
  
  # Extract P-value; fallback to Normal model if missing in Firth
  p_val <- firth_model$prob[idx_f]
  if (is.na(p_val)) {
    norm_coef_summary <- summary(normal_model)$coefficients
    if (term_name %in% rownames(norm_coef_summary)) p_val <- norm_coef_summary[term_name, "Pr(>|z|)"]
  }
  
  data.frame(
    Variable = display_name,
    HR = round(hr, 2),
    CI_95 = ci_text,
    P_value = if(is.na(p_val)) "NC" else format.pval(p_val, digits = 3, eps = 0.001),
    p_num = if(is.na(p_val)) NA else p_val,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}


# --- CSE SECTION ---
res1_cse <- extract_row(fit_cse_1, fit_norm_1, "cUTI.CRE", "cUTI-CRE")
res2_cse <- extract_row(fit_cse_2, fit_norm_1, "BSI.CRE", "BSI-CRE")
res3_cse <- extract_row(fit_cse_3, fit_norm_1, "Pneumonia.CRE", "Pneumonia-CRE")

# Extract Covariates for CSE (using fit_cse_1 as covariates are consistent across models)
covs <- names(fit_cse_1$coefficients)[!grepl("infection_group", names(fit_cse_1$coefficients))]
res_cov_cse <- do.call(rbind, lapply(covs, function(v) extract_row(fit_cse_1, fit_norm_1, paste0("^", v, "$"), v)))

df_cse <- rbind(res1_cse, res2_cse, res3_cse, res_cov_cse)
colnames(df_cse)[-1] <- paste0(colnames(df_cse)[-1], "_cse")

# --- NE SECTION ---
# Search by pattern in fit_ne (R may convert hyphens to dots, e.g., cUTI-CRE to cUTI.CRE)
res1_ne <- extract_row(fit_ne, fit_norm_ne, "cUTI.CRE", "cUTI-CRE")
res2_ne <- extract_row(fit_ne, fit_norm_ne, "BSI.CRE", "BSI-CRE")
res3_ne <- extract_row(fit_ne, fit_norm_ne, "Pneumonia.CRE", "Pneumonia-CRE")

# Extract Covariates for NE
res_cov_ne <- do.call(rbind, lapply(covs, function(v) extract_row(fit_ne, fit_norm_ne, paste0("^", v, "$"), v)))

df_ne <- rbind(res1_ne, res2_ne, res3_ne, res_cov_ne)
colnames(df_ne)[-1] <- paste0(colnames(df_ne)[-1], "_ne")

# --- MERGE & TABLE GENERATION ---
final_df <- full_join(df_cse, df_ne, by = "Variable") %>%
  filter(!is.na(HR_cse) | !is.na(HR_ne)) # Remove empty rows if any

final_table <- flextable(final_df, col_keys = c("Variable", "HR_cse", "CI_95_cse", "P_value_cse", "HR_ne", "CI_95_ne", "P_value_ne")) %>%
  set_header_labels(
    Variable = "Variables", 
    HR_cse = "HR", 
    CI_95_cse = "95% CI", 
    P_value_cse = "p-value", 
    HR_ne = "HR", 
    CI_95_ne = "95% CI", 
    P_value_ne = "p-value"
  ) %>%
  add_header_row(
    values = c("", "CRE vs. CSE", "CRE vs. NE"), 
    colwidths = c(1, 3, 3)
  ) %>%
  theme_booktabs() %>% 
  autofit() %>%
  bold(i = ~ !is.na(p_num_cse) & p_num_cse < 0.05, j = "P_value_cse") %>%
  bold(i = ~ !is.na(p_num_ne) & p_num_ne < 0.05, j = "P_value_ne")
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='hide'}
#========================================================
# 6. Function to extract HR, 95% CI and p-value
#========================================================

extract_row <- function(firth_model, normal_model, pattern, display_name) {
  
  all_names <- names(firth_model$coefficients)
  
  idx_f <- grep(pattern, all_names)
  
  if (length(idx_f) == 0) {
    return(
      data.frame(
        Variable = display_name,
        HR = NA,
        CI_95 = "",
        P_value = "",
        p_num = NA,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    )
  }
  
  idx_f <- idx_f[1]
  term_name <- all_names[idx_f]
  
  coef_f <- firth_model$coefficients[idx_f]
  hr <- exp(coef_f)
  
  se_f <- tryCatch(
    sqrt(diag(firth_model$var))[idx_f],
    error = function(e) NA
  )
  
  if (is.na(se_f)) {
    norm_summary <- summary(normal_model)$coefficients
    
    se_to_use <- if (term_name %in% rownames(norm_summary)) {
      norm_summary[term_name, "se(coef)"]
    } else {
      NA
    }
  } else {
    se_to_use <- se_f
  }
  
  ci_text <- if (!is.na(se_to_use)) {
    paste0(
      round(exp(coef_f - 1.96 * se_to_use), 2),
      " - ",
      round(exp(coef_f + 1.96 * se_to_use), 2)
    )
  } else {
    "NC"
  }
  
  p_val <- firth_model$prob[idx_f]
  
  if (is.na(p_val)) {
    norm_coef_summary <- summary(normal_model)$coefficients
    
    if (term_name %in% rownames(norm_coef_summary)) {
      p_val <- norm_coef_summary[term_name, "Pr(>|z|)"]
    }
  }
  
  data.frame(
    Variable = display_name,
    HR = round(hr, 2),
    CI_95 = ci_text,
    P_value = if (is.na(p_val)) {
      "NC"
    } else {
      format.pval(p_val, digits = 3, eps = 0.001)
    },
    p_num = if (is.na(p_val)) NA else p_val,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

#========================================================
# 7. Extract main comparisons
#========================================================

res_hai <- extract_row(
  firth_model = fit_ori_1,
  normal_model = fit_norm_ori_1,
  pattern = "ori_infect_groupHAI.CRE|ori_infect_groupHAI-CRE",
  display_name = "HAI-CRE vs HAI-CSE"
)

res_cai <- extract_row(
  firth_model = fit_ori_2,
  normal_model = fit_norm_ori_2,
  pattern = "ori_infect_groupCAI.CRE|ori_infect_groupCAI-CRE",
  display_name = "CAI-CRE vs CAI-CSE"
)

df_main <- rbind(res_hai, res_cai)

df_main

#========================================================
# 8. Extract covariates from Model 1
#========================================================

covs <- names(fit_ori_1$coefficients)[
  !grepl("ori_infect_group", names(fit_ori_1$coefficients))
]

res_cov <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(
    covs,
    function(v) {
      extract_row(
        firth_model = fit_ori_1,
        normal_model = fit_norm_ori_1,
        pattern = paste0("^", v, "$"),
        display_name = v
      )
    }
  )
)

df_final <- rbind(df_main, res_cov) %>%
  filter(!is.na(HR))

#========================================================
# 9. Create final table
#========================================================

final_table <- flextable(
  df_final,
  col_keys = c("Variable", "HR", "CI_95", "P_value")
) %>%
  set_header_labels(
    Variable = "Variables",
    HR = "HR",
    CI_95 = "95% CI",
    P_value = "p-value"
  ) %>%
  add_header_row(
    values = c("", "CRE vs CSE"),
    colwidths = c(1, 3)
  ) %>%
  theme_booktabs() %>%
  autofit() %>%
  bold(
    i = ~ !is.na(p_num) & p_num < 0.05,
    j = "P_value"
  )
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='hide'}
## =========================================================
## 3) Bootstrap for SE + CI
## =========================================================
boot.clos <- function(data, state.names, tra, cens.name = "cens", s = 0, nboot = 500, seed = 1) {
  set.seed(seed)
  
  ids <- unique(data$id)
  idx_list <- split(seq_len(nrow(data)), data$id)
  
  res <- numeric(nboot)
  
  for (b in seq_len(nboot)) {
    samp_ids <- sample(ids, length(ids), replace = TRUE)
    
    inds <- unlist(idx_list[as.character(samp_ids)], use.names = FALSE)
    dboot <- data[inds, , drop = FALSE]
    
    # remap sampled IDs to 1..N to keep etm happy
    dboot$id <- rep.int(seq_along(samp_ids),
                        times = lengths(idx_list[as.character(samp_ids)]))
    
    tr.prob <- etm::etm(dboot, state.names, tra, cens.name, s, cova = FALSE)
    res[b] <- etm::clos(tr.prob)$e.phi
  }
  
  res
}

boot_vals <- boot.clos(
  data       = newdat_ne_his_2122,
  state.names = state.names,
  tra        = tra,
  cens.name  = "cens",
  s          = 0,
  nboot      = 1000,   
  seed       = 2026
)

se_ne_his <- sd(boot_vals)
se_ne_his

## =========================================================
## 5) Make summary table – Percentile CI only
## =========================================================

# helper: percentile CI + SE + format
summ_perc <- function(phi, boot_vals, label, probs = c(0.025, 0.975)) {
  if (is.null(phi) || length(phi) == 0 || is.na(phi) ||
      is.null(boot_vals) || length(boot_vals) == 0) {
    return(data.frame(
      analysis = label,
      phi = NA_real_,
      se  = NA_real_,
      ci_l = NA_real_,
      ci_u = NA_real_,
      nboot = ifelse(is.null(boot_vals), NA_integer_, length(boot_vals)),
      estimate_ci = NA_character_,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }
  
  ci <- as.numeric(quantile(boot_vals, probs = probs, na.rm = TRUE, type = 6))
  se <- sd(boot_vals, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  data.frame(
    analysis = label,
    phi = as.numeric(phi),
    se  = se,
    ci_l = ci[1],
    ci_u = ci[2],
    nboot = length(boot_vals),
    estimate_ci = sprintf("%.2f [%.2f, %.2f]", phi, ci[1], ci[2]),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}


# - Overall: phi, boot_vals
# - BSI:     phi_bsi, boot_vals_bsi
# - PNEU:    phi_pneu, boot_vals_pneu
# - CUTI:    phi_cuti, boot_vals_cuti
```

```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='hide'}
## =========================================================
## 3) Bootstrap for SE + CI
## =========================================================
boot.clos <- function(data, state.names, tra, cens.name = "cens", s = 0, nboot = 500, seed = 1) {
  set.seed(seed)
  
  ids <- unique(data$id)
  idx_list <- split(seq_len(nrow(data)), data$id)
  
  res <- numeric(nboot)
  
  for (b in seq_len(nboot)) {
    samp_ids <- sample(ids, length(ids), replace = TRUE)
    
    inds <- unlist(idx_list[as.character(samp_ids)], use.names = FALSE)
    dboot <- data[inds, , drop = FALSE]
    
    # remap sampled IDs to 1..N to keep etm happy
    dboot$id <- rep.int(seq_along(samp_ids),
                        times = lengths(idx_list[as.character(samp_ids)]))
    
    tr.prob <- etm::etm(dboot, state.names, tra, cens.name, s, cova = FALSE)
    res[b] <- etm::clos(tr.prob)$e.phi
  }
  
  res
}

boot_vals <- boot.clos(
  data       = newdat_ne_his_2122,
  state.names = state.names,
  tra        = tra,
  cens.name  = "cens",
  s          = 0,
  nboot      = 1000,

)
```

```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
## =========================================================
## 5) Make summary table – Percentile CI only
## =========================================================

# helper: percentile CI + SE + format
summ_perc <- function(phi, boot_vals, label, probs = c(0.025, 0.975)) {
  if (is.null(phi) || length(phi) == 0 || is.na(phi) ||
      is.null(boot_vals) || length(boot_vals) == 0) {
    return(data.frame(
      analysis = label,
      phi = NA_real_,
      se  = NA_real_,
      ci_l = NA_real_,
      ci_u = NA_real_,
      nboot = ifelse(is.null(boot_vals), NA_integer_, length(boot_vals)),
      estimate_ci = NA_character_,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }
  
  ci <- as.numeric(quantile(boot_vals, probs = probs, na.rm = TRUE, type = 6))
  se <- sd(boot_vals, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  data.frame(
    analysis = label,
    phi = as.numeric(phi),
    se  = se,
    ci_l = ci[1],
    ci_u = ci[2],
    nboot = length(boot_vals),
    estimate_ci = sprintf("%.2f [%.2f, %.2f]", phi, ci[1], ci[2]),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}


# - Overall: phi, boot_vals
# - BSI:     phi_bsi, boot_vals_bsi
# - PNEU:    phi_pneu, boot_vals_pneu
# - CUTI:    phi_cuti, boot_vals_cuti

tab_perc <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  summ_perc(phi,      boot_vals,      "Overall CRE patients"),
  summ_perc(phi_bsi,  boot_vals_bsi,  "BSI"),
  summ_perc(phi_pneu, boot_vals_pneu, "PNEUMONIA"),
  summ_perc(phi_cuti, boot_vals_cuti, "cUTI")
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    phi  = round(phi,  2),
    se   = round(se,   2),
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='hide'}
## =========================================================
## 3) Bootstrap for SE + CI
## =========================================================
boot.clos <- function(data, state.names, tra, cens.name = "cens", s = 0, nboot = 500, seed = 1) {
  set.seed(seed)
  
  ids <- unique(data$id)
  idx_list <- split(seq_len(nrow(data)), data$id)
  
  res <- numeric(nboot)
  
  for (b in seq_len(nboot)) {
    samp_ids <- sample(ids, length(ids), replace = TRUE)
    
    inds <- unlist(idx_list[as.character(samp_ids)], use.names = FALSE)
    dboot <- data[inds, , drop = FALSE]
    
    # remap sampled IDs to 1..N to keep etm happy
    dboot$id <- rep.int(seq_along(samp_ids),
                        times = lengths(idx_list[as.character(samp_ids)]))
    
    tr.prob <- etm::etm(dboot, state.names, tra, cens.name, s, cova = FALSE)
    res[b] <- etm::clos(tr.prob)$e.phi
  }
  
  res
}

boot_vals <- boot.clos(
  data       = newdat_ne_his,
  state.names = state.names,
  tra        = tra,
  cens.name  = "cens",
  s          = 0,
  nboot      = 1000,   
  seed       = 2026
)

se_ne_his <- sd(boot_vals)
se_ne_his

## ---- 95% CI (Wald)

## =========================================================
## 5) Make summary table – Percentile CI only
## =========================================================

# helper: percentile CI + SE + format
summ_perc <- function(phi, boot_vals, label, probs = c(0.025, 0.975)) {
  if (is.null(phi) || length(phi) == 0 || is.na(phi) ||
      is.null(boot_vals) || length(boot_vals) == 0) {
    return(data.frame(
      analysis = label,
      phi = NA_real_,
      se  = NA_real_,
      ci_l = NA_real_,
      ci_u = NA_real_,
      nboot = ifelse(is.null(boot_vals), NA_integer_, length(boot_vals)),
      estimate_ci = NA_character_,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }
  
  ci <- as.numeric(quantile(boot_vals, probs = probs, na.rm = TRUE, type = 6))
  se <- sd(boot_vals, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  data.frame(
    analysis = label,
    phi = as.numeric(phi),
    se  = se,
    ci_l = ci[1],
    ci_u = ci[2],
    nboot = length(boot_vals),
    estimate_ci = sprintf("%.2f [%.2f, %.2f]", phi, ci[1], ci[2]),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}


# - Overall: phi, boot_vals
# - BSI:     phi_bsi, boot_vals_bsi
# - PNEU:    phi_pneu, boot_vals_pneu
# - CUTI:    phi_cuti, boot_vals_cuti
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
  summ_perc(phi_bsi,  boot_vals_bsi,  "BSI"),
  summ_perc(phi_pneu, boot_vals_pneu, "PNEUMONIA"),
  summ_perc(phi_cuti, boot_vals_cuti, "cUTI")
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    phi  = round(phi,  2),
    se   = round(se,   2),
    ci_l = round(ci_l, 2),
    ci_u = round(ci_u, 2)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(analysis, estimate_ci, nboot)
```

```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='hide'}
## =========================================================
## 3) Bootstrap for SE + CI
## =========================================================
boot.clos <- function(data, state.names, tra, cens.name = "cens", s = 0, nboot = 500, seed = 1) {
  set.seed(seed)
  
  ids <- unique(data$id)
  idx_list <- split(seq_len(nrow(data)), data$id)
  
  res <- numeric(nboot)
  
  for (b in seq_len(nboot)) {
    samp_ids <- sample(ids, length(ids), replace = TRUE)
    
    inds <- unlist(idx_list[as.character(samp_ids)], use.names = FALSE)
    dboot <- data[inds, , drop = FALSE]
    
    # remap sampled IDs to 1..N to keep etm happy
    dboot$id <- rep.int(seq_along(samp_ids),
                        times = lengths(idx_list[as.character(samp_ids)]))
    
    tr.prob <- etm::etm(dboot, state.names, tra, cens.name, s, cova = FALSE)
    res[b] <- etm::clos(tr.prob)$e.phi
  }
  
  res
}

boot_vals <- boot.clos(
  data       = newdat_ne_his,
  state.names = state.names,
  tra        = tra,
  cens.name  = "cens",
  s          = 0,
  nboot      = 1000,   
  seed       = 2026
)

## =========================================================
## 5) Make summary table – Percentile CI only
## =========================================================

# helper: percentile CI + SE + format
summ_perc <- function(phi, boot_vals, label, probs = c(0.025, 0.975)) {
  if (is.null(phi) || length(phi) == 0 || is.na(phi) ||
      is.null(boot_vals) || length(boot_vals) == 0) {
    return(data.frame(
      analysis = label,
      phi = NA_real_,
      se  = NA_real_,
      ci_l = NA_real_,
      ci_u = NA_real_,
      nboot = ifelse(is.null(boot_vals), NA_integer_, length(boot_vals)),
      estimate_ci = NA_character_,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }
  
  ci <- as.numeric(quantile(boot_vals, probs = probs, na.rm = TRUE, type = 6))
  se <- sd(boot_vals, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  data.frame(
    analysis = label,
    phi = as.numeric(phi),
    se  = se,
    ci_l = ci[1],
    ci_u = ci[2],
    nboot = length(boot_vals),
    estimate_ci = sprintf("%.2f [%.2f, %.2f]", phi, ci[1], ci[2]),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}


# - Overall: phi, boot_vals
# - BSI:     phi_bsi, boot_vals_bsi
# - PNEU:    phi_pneu, boot_vals_pneu
# - CUTI:    phi_cuti, boot_vals_cuti
```

```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
tab_perc <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  summ_perc(phi,      boot_vals,      "Overall CRE patients"),
  summ_perc(phi_bsi,  boot_vals_bsi,  "BSI"),
  summ_perc(phi_pneu, boot_vals_pneu, "PNEUMONIA"),
  summ_perc(phi_cuti, boot_vals_cuti, "cUTI")
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    phi  = round(phi,  2),
    se   = round(se,   2),
    ci_l = round(ci_l, 2),
    ci_u = round(ci_u, 2)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(analysis, estimate_ci, nboot)


gt::gt(tab_perc) %>%
  gt::cols_label(
    analysis = "Analysis",
    # phi      = "Excess LoS (days)",

    nboot    = "N bootstrap",
    estimate_ci = "Excess LoS (days) [95% CI]"
  )
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='hide'}
## =========================================================
## 3) Bootstrap for SE + CI
## =========================================================
boot.clos <- function(data, state.names, tra, cens.name = "cens", s = 0, nboot = 500, seed = 1) {
  set.seed(seed)
  
  ids <- unique(data$id)
  idx_list <- split(seq_len(nrow(data)), data$id)
  
  res <- numeric(nboot)
  
  for (b in seq_len(nboot)) {
    samp_ids <- sample(ids, length(ids), replace = TRUE)
    
    inds <- unlist(idx_list[as.character(samp_ids)], use.names = FALSE)
    dboot <- data[inds, , drop = FALSE]
    
    # remap sampled IDs to 1..N to keep etm happy
    dboot$id <- rep.int(seq_along(samp_ids),
                        times = lengths(idx_list[as.character(samp_ids)]))
    
    tr.prob <- etm::etm(dboot, state.names, tra, cens.name, s, cova = FALSE)
    res[b] <- etm::clos(tr.prob)$e.phi
  }
  
  res
}

boot_vals <- boot.clos(
  data       = newdat_ne_his,
  state.names = state.names,
  tra        = tra,
  cens.name  = "cens",
  s          = 0,
  nboot      = 1000,   
  seed       = 2026
)

se_ne_his <- sd(boot_vals)
se_ne_his

## ---- 95% CI (Wald)
ci_wald <- c(phi - 1.96 * se_ne_his, phi + 1.96 * se_ne_his)

## ---- 95% CI (percentile)

ci_perc_txt <- sprintf("%.2f [%.2f, %.2f] (Percentile)", phi, ci_perc[1], ci_perc[2])

## =========================================================
## 5) Make summary table – Percentile CI only
## =========================================================

# helper: percentile CI + SE + format
summ_perc <- function(phi, boot_vals, label, probs = c(0.025, 0.975)) {
  if (is.null(phi) || length(phi) == 0 || is.na(phi) ||
      is.null(boot_vals) || length(boot_vals) == 0) {
    return(data.frame(
      analysis = label,
      phi = NA_real_,
      se  = NA_real_,
      ci_l = NA_real_,
      ci_u = NA_real_,
      nboot = ifelse(is.null(boot_vals), NA_integer_, length(boot_vals)),
      estimate_ci = NA_character_,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }
  
  ci <- as.numeric(quantile(boot_vals, probs = probs, na.rm = TRUE, type = 6))
  se <- sd(boot_vals, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  data.frame(
    analysis = label,
    phi = as.numeric(phi),
    se  = se,
    ci_l = ci[1],
    ci_u = ci[2],
    nboot = length(boot_vals),
    estimate_ci = sprintf("%.2f [%.2f, %.2f]", phi, ci[1], ci[2]),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}


# - Overall: phi, boot_vals
# - BSI:     phi_bsi, boot_vals_bsi
# - PNEU:    phi_pneu, boot_vals_pneu
# - CUTI:    phi_cuti, boot_vals_cuti
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
  summ_perc(phi,      boot_vals,      "Overall CRE patients"),
  summ_perc(phi_bsi,  boot_vals_bsi,  "BSI"),
  summ_perc(phi_pneu, boot_vals_pneu, "PNEUMONIA"),
  summ_perc(phi_cuti, boot_vals_cuti, "cUTI")
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    phi  = round(phi,  2),
    se   = round(se,   2),
    ci_l = round(ci_l, 2),
    ci_u = round(ci_u, 2)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(analysis, estimate_ci, nboot)


gt::gt(tab_perc) %>%
  gt::cols_label(
    analysis = "Analysis",

  )
```

```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='hide'}
## =========================================================
bad <- which(newdat_ne_his$exit <= newdat_ne_his$entry)
length(bad)

if (length(bad) > 0) {
  newdat_ne_his$exit[bad] <- newdat_ne_his$entry[bad] + 1
}

stopifnot(all(newdat_ne_his$exit > newdat_ne_his$entry))

## =========================================================
## 2) Run etm() and clos()
## =========================================================
state.names <- c("0","1","2","3")

tr.prob_ne_his <- etm::etm(
  data       = newdat_ne_his,
  state.names = state.names,
  tra        = tra,
  cens.name  = "cens",
  s          = 0,
  cova       = FALSE
)

cLoS_ne_his <- etm::clos(tr.prob_ne_his)
phi <- cLoS_ne_his$e.phi
phi

## =========================================================
## 3) Bootstrap for SE + CI
## =========================================================
boot.clos <- function(data, state.names, tra, cens.name = "cens", s = 0, nboot = 500, seed = 1) {
  set.seed(seed)
  
  ids <- unique(data$id)
  idx_list <- split(seq_len(nrow(data)), data$id)
  
  res <- numeric(nboot)
  
  for (b in seq_len(nboot)) {
    samp_ids <- sample(ids, length(ids), replace = TRUE)
    
    inds <- unlist(idx_list[as.character(samp_ids)], use.names = FALSE)
    dboot <- data[inds, , drop = FALSE]
    
    # remap sampled IDs to 1..N to keep etm happy
    dboot$id <- rep.int(seq_along(samp_ids),
                        times = lengths(idx_list[as.character(samp_ids)]))
    
    tr.prob <- etm::etm(dboot, state.names, tra, cens.name, s, cova = FALSE)
    res[b] <- etm::clos(tr.prob)$e.phi
  }
  
  res
}

boot_vals <- boot.clos(
  data       = newdat_ne_his,
  state.names = state.names,
  tra        = tra,
  cens.name  = "cens",
  s          = 0,
  nboot      = 1000,   
  seed       = 2026
)

se_ne_his <- sd(boot_vals)
se_ne_his

## ---- 95% CI (Wald)
ci_wald <- c(phi - 1.96 * se_ne_his, phi + 1.96 * se_ne_his)

## ---- 95% CI (percentile)
ci_perc <- as.numeric(quantile(boot_vals, c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE))

## ---- formatted strings
ci_wald_txt <- sprintf("%.2f [%.2f, %.2f] (Wald)", phi, ci_wald[1], ci_wald[2])
ci_perc_txt <- sprintf("%.2f [%.2f, %.2f] (Percentile)", phi, ci_perc[1], ci_perc[2])

ci_wald_txt
ci_perc_txt

  ci_wald_u = ci_wald[2],
  ci_perc_l = ci_perc[1],

## =========================================================
## 5) Make summary table – Percentile CI only
## =========================================================

# helper: percentile CI + SE + format
summ_perc <- function(phi, boot_vals, label, probs = c(0.025, 0.975)) {
  if (is.null(phi) || length(phi) == 0 || is.na(phi) ||
      is.null(boot_vals) || length(boot_vals) == 0) {
    return(data.frame(
      analysis = label,
      phi = NA_real_,
      se  = NA_real_,
      ci_l = NA_real_,
      ci_u = NA_real_,
      nboot = ifelse(is.null(boot_vals), NA_integer_, length(boot_vals)),
      estimate_ci = NA_character_,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }
  
  ci <- as.numeric(quantile(boot_vals, probs = probs, na.rm = TRUE, type = 6))
  se <- sd(boot_vals, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  data.frame(
    analysis = label,
    phi = as.numeric(phi),
    se  = se,
    ci_l = ci[1],
    ci_u = ci[2],
    nboot = length(boot_vals),
    estimate_ci = sprintf("%.2f [%.2f, %.2f]", phi, ci[1], ci[2]),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}


# - Overall: phi, boot_vals
# - BSI:     phi_bsi, boot_vals_bsi
# - PNEU:    phi_pneu, boot_vals_pneu
# - CUTI:    phi_cuti, boot_vals_cuti
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='hide'}
## =========================================================
## 3) Bootstrap for SE + CI
## =========================================================
boot.clos <- function(data, state.names, tra, cens.name = "cens", s = 0, nboot = 500, seed = 1) {
  set.seed(seed)
  
  ids <- unique(data$id)
  idx_list <- split(seq_len(nrow(data)), data$id)
  
  res <- numeric(nboot)
  
  for (b in seq_len(nboot)) {
    samp_ids <- sample(ids, length(ids), replace = TRUE)
    
    inds <- unlist(idx_list[as.character(samp_ids)], use.names = FALSE)
    dboot <- data[inds, , drop = FALSE]
    
    # remap sampled IDs to 1..N to keep etm happy
    dboot$id <- rep.int(seq_along(samp_ids),
                        times = lengths(idx_list[as.character(samp_ids)]))
    
    tr.prob <- etm::etm(dboot, state.names, tra, cens.name, s, cova = FALSE)
    res[b] <- etm::clos(tr.prob)$e.phi
  }
  
  res
}

boot_vals <- boot.clos(
  data       = newdat_ne_his,
  state.names = state.names,
  tra        = tra,
  cens.name  = "cens",
  s          = 0,
  nboot      = 1000,

)

## =========================================================
## 5) Make summary table – Percentile CI only
## =========================================================

# helper: percentile CI + SE + format
summ_perc <- function(phi, boot_vals, label, probs = c(0.025, 0.975)) {
  if (is.null(phi) || length(phi) == 0 || is.na(phi) ||
      is.null(boot_vals) || length(boot_vals) == 0) {
    return(data.frame(
      analysis = label,
      phi = NA_real_,
      se  = NA_real_,
      ci_l = NA_real_,
      ci_u = NA_real_,
      nboot = ifelse(is.null(boot_vals), NA_integer_, length(boot_vals)),
      estimate_ci = NA_character_,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }
  
  ci <- as.numeric(quantile(boot_vals, probs = probs, na.rm = TRUE, type = 6))
  se <- sd(boot_vals, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  data.frame(
    analysis = label,
    phi = as.numeric(phi),
    se  = se,
    ci_l = ci[1],
    ci_u = ci[2],
    nboot = length(boot_vals),
    estimate_ci = sprintf("%.2f [%.2f, %.2f]", phi, ci[1], ci[2]),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}


# - Overall: phi, boot_vals
# - BSI:     phi_bsi, boot_vals_bsi
# - PNEU:    phi_pneu, boot_vals_pneu
# - CUTI:    phi_cuti, boot_vals_cuti
```

```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='hide'}
## =========================================================
## 3) Bootstrap for SE + CI
## =========================================================
boot.clos <- function(data, state.names, tra, cens.name = "cens", s = 0, nboot = 500, seed = 1) {
  set.seed(seed)
  
  ids <- unique(data$id)
  idx_list <- split(seq_len(nrow(data)), data$id)
  
  res <- numeric(nboot)
  
  for (b in seq_len(nboot)) {
    samp_ids <- sample(ids, length(ids), replace = TRUE)
    
    inds <- unlist(idx_list[as.character(samp_ids)], use.names = FALSE)
    dboot <- data[inds, , drop = FALSE]
    
    # remap sampled IDs to 1..N to keep etm happy
    dboot$id <- rep.int(seq_along(samp_ids),
                        times = lengths(idx_list[as.character(samp_ids)]))
    
    tr.prob <- etm::etm(dboot, state.names, tra, cens.name, s, cova = FALSE)
    res[b] <- etm::clos(tr.prob)$e.phi
  }
  
  res
}

boot_vals <- boot.clos(
  data       = newdat_ne_his,
  state.names = state.names,
  tra        = tra,
  cens.name  = "cens",
  s          = 0,
  nboot      = 1000,   
  seed       = 2026
)

## =========================================================
## 5) Make summary table – Percentile CI only
## =========================================================

# helper: percentile CI + SE + format
summ_perc <- function(phi, boot_vals, label, probs = c(0.025, 0.975)) {
  if (is.null(phi) || length(phi) == 0 || is.na(phi) ||
      is.null(boot_vals) || length(boot_vals) == 0) {
    return(data.frame(
      analysis = label,
      phi = NA_real_,
      se  = NA_real_,
      ci_l = NA_real_,
      ci_u = NA_real_,
      nboot = ifelse(is.null(boot_vals), NA_integer_, length(boot_vals)),
      estimate_ci = NA_character_,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }
  
  ci <- as.numeric(quantile(boot_vals, probs = probs, na.rm = TRUE, type = 6))
  se <- sd(boot_vals, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  data.frame(
    analysis = label,
    phi = as.numeric(phi),
    se  = se,
    ci_l = ci[1],
    ci_u = ci[2],
    nboot = length(boot_vals),
    estimate_ci = sprintf("%.2f [%.2f, %.2f]", phi, ci[1], ci[2]),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}


# - Overall: phi, boot_vals
# - BSI:     phi_bsi, boot_vals_bsi
# - PNEU:    phi_pneu, boot_vals_pneu
# - CUTI:    phi_cuti, boot_vals_cuti
```

```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    phi  = round(phi,  2),
    se   = round(se,   2),
    ci_l = round(ci_l, 2),
    ci_u = round(ci_u, 2)
  ) %>%
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='hide'}
## =========================================================
## 3) Bootstrap for SE + CI
## =========================================================
boot.clos <- function(data, state.names, tra, cens.name = "cens", s = 0, nboot = 500, seed = 1) {
  set.seed(seed)
  
  ids <- unique(data$id)
  idx_list <- split(seq_len(nrow(data)), data$id)
  
  res <- numeric(nboot)
  
  for (b in seq_len(nboot)) {
    samp_ids <- sample(ids, length(ids), replace = TRUE)
    
    inds <- unlist(idx_list[as.character(samp_ids)], use.names = FALSE)
    dboot <- data[inds, , drop = FALSE]
    
    # remap sampled IDs to 1..N to keep etm happy
    dboot$id <- rep.int(seq_along(samp_ids),
                        times = lengths(idx_list[as.character(samp_ids)]))
    
    tr.prob <- etm::etm(dboot, state.names, tra, cens.name, s, cova = FALSE)
    res[b] <- etm::clos(tr.prob)$e.phi
  }
  
  res
}

boot_vals <- boot.clos(
  data       = newdat_ne_his,
  state.names = state.names,
  tra        = tra,
  cens.name  = "cens",
  s          = 0,
  nboot      = 1000,   
  seed       = 2026
)

### PNEUMONIA

data_los_his_inf_ss2_pneu <- data_los_his_inf_ss2 %>% 
  filter(Group=="CRE", PNEUMONIA==TRUE) %>% 
  bind_rows(., data_los_his_inf_ss2_ne)
state.names <- c("0","1","2","3")


#### Change in Length of Stay associated with an intermediate event (infection)


## -------------------------
## DATA PREP – PNEUMONIA 
## -------------------------

## 1) infected / had intermediate event
newdat_ne_his_pneu <- etm::etmprep(
  c(NA, "t.en", "t.dis", "t.death"),
  c(NA, "stat.en", "stat.recovery", "stat.death"),
  data      = subset(data_los_his_inf_ss2_pneu, stat.en == 1),
  tra       = tra,
  cens.name = "cens",
  id        = "id"
)

## 2) non-infected: single transition 0 -> (2/3/cens)
d0 <- subset(data_los_his_inf_ss2_pneu, stat.en == 0)

tmp <- with(d0, data.frame(
  id    = id,
  entry = 0,
  exit  = t.dis,
  from  = "0",
  to    = ifelse(stat.recovery == 1, "2",
                 ifelse(stat.death == 1,    "3", "cens"))
))

## harmonize types before rbind
newdat_ne_his_pneu$from <- as.character(newdat_ne_his_pneu$from)
newdat_ne_his_pneu$to   <- as.character(newdat_ne_his_pneu$to)
tmp$from <- as.character(tmp$from)
tmp$to   <- as.character(tmp$to)

newdat_ne_his_pneu <- rbind(newdat_ne_his_pneu, tmp)

## -------------------------
## Fix time constraint: exit must be > entry
## -------------------------
bad <- which(newdat_ne_his_pneu$exit <= newdat_ne_his_pneu$entry)
cat("N rows with exit<=entry:", length(bad), "\n")

if (length(bad) > 0) {
  newdat_ne_his_pneu$exit[bad] <- newdat_ne_his_pneu$entry[bad] + 1
}
stopifnot(all(newdat_ne_his_pneu$exit > newdat_ne_his_pneu$entry))

## -------------------------
## ETM + cLoS (PNEUMONIA)
## -------------------------
tr.prob_ne_his_pneu <- etm::etm(
  data        = newdat_ne_his_pneu,
  state.names = state.names,
  tra         = tra,
  cens.name   = "cens",
  s           = 0,
  cova        = FALSE
)

cLoS_ne_his_pneu <- etm::clos(tr.prob_ne_his_pneu)
print(cLoS_ne_his_pneu)

phi_pneu <- cLoS_ne_his_pneu$e.phi
cat("phi (e.phi) =", phi_pneu, "\n")

## If phi is NA/NULL, print transition to debug
if (is.null(phi_pneu) || is.na(phi_pneu)) {
  cat("WARNING: e.phi is NA/NULL. Transition table:\n")
  print(table(newdat_ne_his_pneu$from, newdat_ne_his_pneu$to))
} else {
  
  ## -------------------------
  ## BOOTSTRAP – PNEUMONIA
  ## -------------------------
  boot_vals_pneu <- boot.clos(
    data        = newdat_ne_his_pneu,
    state.names = state.names,
    tra         = tra,
    cens.name   = "cens",
    s           = 0,
    nboot       = 1000,   
    seed        = 2026
  )
  
  se_pneu <- sd(boot_vals_pneu)
  cat("Bootstrap SE =", se_pneu, "\n")
  
  ## 95% CI
  ci_wald_pneu <- c(phi_pneu - 1.96 * se_pneu,
                    phi_pneu + 1.96 * se_pneu)
  
  ci_perc_pneu <- as.numeric(
    quantile(boot_vals_pneu, c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE)
  )
  
  ## Print results
  cat(sprintf("Wald 95%% CI: %.2f [%.2f, %.2f]\n", phi_pneu, ci_wald_pneu[1], ci_wald_pneu[2]))
  cat(sprintf("Percentile 95%% CI: %.2f [%.2f, %.2f]\n", phi_pneu, ci_perc_pneu[1], ci_perc_pneu[2]))
  
  ## Plots
  # hist(boot_vals_pneu, breaks = 30,
  #      main = "Bootstrap distribution of e.phi (PNEUMONIA)",
  #      xlab = "e.phi")
  # abline(v = phi_pneu, lwd = 2)
}

## =========================================================
## 5) Make summary table – Percentile CI only
## =========================================================

# helper: percentile CI + SE + format
summ_perc <- function(phi, boot_vals, label, probs = c(0.025, 0.975)) {
  if (is.null(phi) || length(phi) == 0 || is.na(phi) ||
      is.null(boot_vals) || length(boot_vals) == 0) {
    return(data.frame(
      analysis = label,
      phi = NA_real_,
      se  = NA_real_,
      ci_l = NA_real_,
      ci_u = NA_real_,
      nboot = ifelse(is.null(boot_vals), NA_integer_, length(boot_vals)),
      estimate_ci = NA_character_,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }
  
  ci <- as.numeric(quantile(boot_vals, probs = probs, na.rm = TRUE, type = 6))
  se <- sd(boot_vals, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  data.frame(
    analysis = label,
    phi = as.numeric(phi),
    se  = se,
    ci_l = ci[1],
    ci_u = ci[2],
    nboot = length(boot_vals),
    estimate_ci = sprintf("%.2f [%.2f, %.2f]", phi, ci[1], ci[2]),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}


# - Overall: phi, boot_vals
# - BSI:     phi_bsi, boot_vals_bsi
# - PNEU:    phi_pneu, boot_vals_pneu
# - CUTI:    phi_cuti, boot_vals_cuti
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
) %>%

    phi  = round(phi,  2),

    ci_l = round(ci_l, 2),
```

```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='hide'}
## =========================================================
## 3) Bootstrap for SE + CI
## =========================================================
boot.clos <- function(data, state.names, tra, cens.name = "cens", s = 0, nboot = 500, seed = 1) {
  set.seed(seed)
  
  ids <- unique(data$id)
  idx_list <- split(seq_len(nrow(data)), data$id)
  
  res <- numeric(nboot)
  
  for (b in seq_len(nboot)) {
    samp_ids <- sample(ids, length(ids), replace = TRUE)
    
    inds <- unlist(idx_list[as.character(samp_ids)], use.names = FALSE)
    dboot <- data[inds, , drop = FALSE]
    
    # remap sampled IDs to 1..N to keep etm happy
    dboot$id <- rep.int(seq_along(samp_ids),
                        times = lengths(idx_list[as.character(samp_ids)]))
    
    tr.prob <- etm::etm(dboot, state.names, tra, cens.name, s, cova = FALSE)
    res[b] <- etm::clos(tr.prob)$e.phi
  }
  
  res
}

boot_vals <- boot.clos(
  data       = newdat_ne_his,
  state.names = state.names,
  tra        = tra,
  cens.name  = "cens",
  s          = 0,
  nboot      = 1000,   
  seed       = 2026
)
```
